intro: Write your streams here: they show on your site (the schedule, the chat bot…) as soon as you save. Times are in the {tz} time zone.
none: No stream yet. Fill in the form below.
confirmDelete: Delete this stream? This cannot be undone.
hStartTime: For example 21:00. Not needed for an all-day stream.
hEndTime: For example 23:30. An end time earlier than the start time means the stream ends the next day. Without an end time, it stays shown for 2 hours.
hGames: The exact name of the game, to find its cover. Several games: separate them with a comma (3 at most). Leave empty for a night without a game.
hAllDay: Best avoided for a stream: pick a time instead.
hRepeatUntil: Without a date, the stream comes back every week until you delete it.
hSkip: For a week without a stream: write the date, for example 2026-12-24. Several dates: separate them with a comma.
hCancelled: A cancelled stream stays in this list; the schedule can show it crossed out or hide it.
errStartTime: The start time is not valid (example: 21:00), or choose “All day”.
errEndTime: The end time is not valid (example: 23:30).
errUntil: The end date of the repeat is not valid or comes before the first stream.
errSkip: The dates to skip are not valid: write them like 2026-12-24, separated by a comma.
errMax: You reached the limit of {n} streams: delete the oldest ones.
